"},{"children":[{"color":"","heading":0,"id":"e7c84de37d22484f5f804b7cb7b9a83e","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"c91091a4468ef101eedb2b03d2ab54bd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"眼耳及鼻舌，身意等六情，"},{"color":"","id":"d3b6f909d44c1ddd9129f065bce13682","modified":1612428947458,"text":"此眼等六情，行色等六尘。"},{"id":"4073e08e22669ba2b8084f66888c892a","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"0db84c0b72d68ea789e7577ed2e24f60","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是眼则不能，自见其己体。"},{"id":"9464142ea92eda978402848b4ceebf7b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若不能自见，云何见余物？"},{"id":"c521b5b2aa0e7f7f1c94af9cfc1c9d2f","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"1506e00e8f96d2fb81bb6f491e173df5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"火喻则不能，成于眼见法。"},{"color":"","id":"99112d51e322bf8d04e18e81ff3c238c","modified":1612428947458,"text":"去未去去时，已总答是事。"},{"id":"77f77031c9d2735a5f42885be4df4fd0","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"fa0745e91809dcf522b79ca1dd2d24e3","modified":1612428947458,"text":"见若未见时，则不名为见，"},{"color":"","id":"e4e41ead58ed1fa6f874ee9c229353f0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"而言见能见，是事则不然。"},{"id":"5b6a858f60c7952ab931f1d0ac2b50e9","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"e523b2a642f7ae96b1bfad6403ac3f02","modified":1612428947458,"text":"见不能有见，非见亦不见。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"90ba7edae41f8326568d9a5cd9ee8590","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破承许根为见者"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"654abd8b6aa79e05c6ccf179980047a0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若已破于见，则为破见者。"},{"id":"94f87b58c7dee0eadfc573344fcce091","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"1692c7e7ef7899d57232061adefd4d05","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离见不离见，见者不可得。"},{"color":"","id":"f9b4fd43f030c0de36cd6ae1cc05937d","modified":1612428947458,"text":"以无见者故，何有见可见？"},{"id":"0022a9d085f53719f4062e802747ef7d","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"7667f01aa17a2c1eccf2b780fb5a4a92","modified":1612428947458,"text":"见可见无故，识等四法无。"},{"color":"","id":"7038dd67edd08d0ac4d89bd859eb2150","modified":1612428947458,"text":"近取等诸缘，云何当得有？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"d82561ce450d1762abe6b47a17c795ed","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破承许我或识为见者"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"f06b696f6ac41b5b89b50d51e1952b25","modified":1612428947458,"text":"耳鼻舌身意，声及闻者等，"},{"color":"","id":"09f096d1a5bcafa0ae85e15b9fb543e4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"当知如是义，皆同于上说。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"a707305da3bdaaf62524eb49bd626309","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、以此理亦可破斥其他立宗"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"43ee0efda65653bde0becc1e1dc0b182","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"a3edca2bb15987c411b8fa4767d80c9f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"三 、观六情品"},{"children":[{"color":"","heading":0,"id":"24c145bcd0d69288ec8781840bf9ddba","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"b1119971c7fd18d2373ba83946d8e061","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若离于色因，色则不可得。"},{"color":"","id":"d8cce33925948892145714ea82b3f7dc","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若当离于色，色因不可得。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"b3320570004a0175deac9e9b95ffa37e","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、立宗"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"39b34620d712bbc87de7598f1f1e4916","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离色因有色，是色则无因。"},{"color":"","id":"cf1ab43d0762597efb60c99a096325fd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"无因而有法，是事则不然。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"fafe9da8306b2e1b6e74fc9e02f9844f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、理由之一"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"089e9013e7b458433f51caf8fc831f3b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若离色有因，则是无果因。"},{"color":"","id":"13c8837557404c040a00d3185193db50","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若言无果因，则无有是处。"},{"id":"d42c34af7313171ca3e163c6684e30cf","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"46531c47a61d9741b58ecbc875091daa","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若已有色者，则不用色因。"},{"color":"","id":"21181cf4501951f951a18c73052033c0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若无有色者，亦不用色因。"},{"id":"ee48a399d4ea7e692a80045582a6b18a","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"8942602aaf6b33a4eccd05e6140fc7cd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"无因而有色，是事终不然。"},{"color":"","id":"116f705903225f205680215d30966540","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是故有智者，不应分别色。"},{"id":"f046b8bef171bd2254006b51e8d297d1","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"ae01b390260d023cbd1d39881a0a4b8e","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若果似于因，是事则不然。"},{"color":"","id":"f1f2172a499bbade1cbf4d4203c688dc","modified":1612428947458,"text":"果若不似因，是事亦不然。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"89d50aec2c88e49b2a65747cd096c189","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、理由之二"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"44110bca29e8f7fe588b2a1d9d92c1da","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、理由"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"e539b003e4c27ecb51a83ca8961d827e","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破色蕴"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"71bb1c6a388922e56ca0d02747aabbd2","modified":1612428947458,"text":"受阴及想阴，行阴识阴等。"},{"color":"","id":"9cb9b79596f80a96c3c798af9b709fe3","modified":1612428947458,"text":"其余一切法，皆同于色阴。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"7bbb7c54f47736f282464bccb30aca99","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以此理亦可遮破他法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"a7df9fdfdfea595564bad20dd403ec33","modified":1612428947458,"text":"以空辩论时，若人欲答辩，"},{"color":"","id":"97a27cc4545bba9f4fe3dbf5cb80b070","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是则不成答，俱同所立故。"},{"id":"19a099b40269dc3643d29e5ba96c8be9","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"10a66794b9c5dc64fe78f61039b00c1c","modified":1612428947458,"text":"解说空性时，若人言其过。"},{"color":"","id":"4a27208a6e5aec59e3242ae1b96902fb","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是则不成过，俱同于所立。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"cb35cdcfa04faf43534d79eb9310d5e5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、辩驳之理"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"c8b27de937acb4a3c25af96271f6cb73","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"9925f20775988a921519b846a4701d94","modified":1612428947458,"text":"四 、观五阴品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"d55f2fabbaf94d6adf03a55d58a19ba8","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"ea2055062d3db7dc04dd6c6baa1dff1e","modified":1612428947458,"text":"空相未有时，则无虚空法。"},{"id":"d9ae3192241df1f6072602d1f3a9bba7","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若先有虚空，即为是无相。"},{"id":"a6d29cb97d6a2ab9b252c62957176692","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"7c2c5e6a47273e5c6889396771d53ed7","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是无相之法，一切处无有。"},{"color":"","id":"a86a9723801d4b7a789ef228f06c553e","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若无无相法，法相依何成？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"485721948ac2f4dc3bb1258baa6210e5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"遮破事相"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"01506e3ba196f5860f9ad2dbb1b43af0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有相无相中，相则无所住。"},{"color":"","id":"8c163f49413f85c3d19f1f3688fca6de","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离有相无相，余处亦不住。"},{"id":"0948b5a018bf33ccd81df29bfe11b6b6","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"f118a9e40f8713e9a6479ace33429e3a","modified":1612428947458,"text":"相法无有故，可相法亦无。"},{"id":"1f4270b4e17328287dde795b0ed89283","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"2bb62f0e12a975d195c9dbf3418d93c0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"可相法无故，相法亦复无。"},{"id":"8557fa9b8b5d4d114f2a8d4c6191bcb2","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"1808e81675267c81aded9a07a7caed55","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是故今无相，亦无有可相。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"a954c7b9f87ef7e7a88f7c5118f1457f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"遮破建立法相之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"207abd26fee962af3ebb1253cfbc927b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离相可相已，更亦无有物。"},{"color":"","id":"1df5c2f60f5c82908ba7e949ee5a7ecb","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若使无有有，云何当有无？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"d22ded1bf7fa73ef1f2b3ad0b5bd522f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"遮破所立"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"589983f0d342c7f52db660a1c5af5bc6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有无俱非中，知有无者谁？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"114b4c1cff938ee7dcb2a0c52edabab6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"遮破能立"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"5278135f41107a74240ba84ba886ec90","modified":1612428947458,"text":"遮破有实无实"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"12246d6e9bea0225fda683d2e7034aa5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是故知虚空，非有亦非无，"},{"color":"","id":"8499596a6eb6f34d9c06fa5bba09486f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"非相非可相。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"0daba0aa2ddfe1d0a3ed395f602ca614","modified":1612428947458,"text":"总摄遮破成立之义"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"8e20eead487c663b9d5994258d116f27","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破空界"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"2d401cf3da26231443188f3c7b0358f1","modified":1612428947458,"text":"余五同虚空。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"b059cc0668cd16b870f02b9f5d6221fe","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以此理亦可遮破他法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"a8acfad52984ca3ba086935c8882072f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"浅智见诸法，若有若无相。"},{"color":"","id":"51c6b72d9665a4268f49c7f447df1fe4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是则不能见，灭见安隐法。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"f7068320c29a5462130da3e5c45e8ac5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、呵斥边执见"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"223f0f44a719431553d1b7d1031aea65","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"b09fdd716e1ab71c0b5a5f8c43ada01e","modified":1612428947458,"text":"五 、观六种品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"baa3df56f50b90863fc9c0af73412d07","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"495af42916fe7cbb4e8879d174bee56c","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若离于染法，先自有染者，"},{"color":"","id":"80d8e3b1a3a43c30722930db8846d65b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"因是染欲者，应生于染法。"},{"color":"","id":"d8aa53caf0310d05687880378e705454","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"c1af87bbb1343f07ba6958ee25bff6d0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若无有染者，云何当有染？"},{"id":"bb282115572b072707c7472c04d42f04","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"eb43b8e6f90374b4d3edf47cfd81876b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"染者复染着，有无次第同。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"7f53988aa448440d14e72dfc36fc0982","modified":1612428947458,"text":" 1、破前后次第而生"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"6a5f18b3ee329b40ab207dd446c9dc00","modified":1612428947458,"text":"染者及染法，俱成则不然。"},{"color":"","id":"8a49554e774bde9475b4c7f64287a5c5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"染者染法俱，则无有相待。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"832abb9e9cc24715e6826bf8f6ee7ca0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、以无观待之过而破"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"12105eb067278e5ed6bd4966c56502cf","modified":1612428947458,"text":"染者染法一，一法云何合？"},{"color":"","id":"d14461ba596e6e3f456fe0f3ebb8b34b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"染者染法异，异法云何合？"},{"id":"a4fff182ae1241dcb9a319257bb82060","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"a932b36adb7c66d407ad3b580cee7fff","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若一有合者，离伴应有合。"},{"color":"","id":"22a4160767200057a4690f83a9606b50","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若异有合者，离伴亦应合。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"bc3149d435a9c86f37e26670f925f93c","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破一异"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"3ee795fa844f3a8b9c251431d935abed","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若异而有合，染染者何事？"},{"color":"","id":"4be015c52db129ad0ff98959244e5d96","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是二相先异，然后说合相。"},{"id":"cc0849a1b3393a76660657d42b6b6fec","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"d1b8fa730d9488ee0e69572191cac2d6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若染及染者，先各成异相，"},{"color":"","id":"ffe3fff59691fbb76d45bd80f8daf2b6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"既已成异相，云何而言合？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"f38c0d06341177ee03afb46632061650","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、宣说合不成立"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"4371bbfffcc02102388160dd4c64e5ee","modified":1612428947458,"text":"异相无有成，是故汝欲合。"},{"color":"","id":"76643677fe26baba94eb57ba5ff4c419","modified":1612428947458,"text":"为使合相成，复说异相乎？"},{"id":"be747720171796d702f0f1540b6054d3","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"d5ee61494f449c32eeeee7b3e159141f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"异相不成故，合相则不成。"},{"color":"","id":"21799332dc142c34e09e5d3daa6e135c","modified":1612428947458,"text":"于何异相中，而欲说合相？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"ace1996e9f1b97f8a6b5bebdd24abbd6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、互相依存之过"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2133f0d28b44272d796b5de899553bf8","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、别破异体"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"c688acc45e14e744a43f872202a51bbe","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破斥结合而成"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"62e095dfb7751bad5dc512adea01a0cf","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破同时而生"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"feca894724dc6db37bd4c9898cf0a69d","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是染染者，非合不合成。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"604b6906a676e54c7fffda810609ea3d","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、摄义"}],"color":"","id":"bac7f8033c3ea253e9dcef5a2b5f997f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破贪欲之惑"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"641d2d6c997fafe4375e11b038e71d81","modified":1612428947458,"text":"诸法亦如是，非合不合成。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"fd5a78eea529ff6e6f3ef1816eb857e1","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以此理亦可遮破他法"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"5bda69da7f0edc15ac386474c06756e9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"5b233ae2a2b0ce73d8457c15a0cb4cb7","modified":1612428947458,"text":"六、观染染者品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"199ed018a3de799af4fa0887d7e69219","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"861bc685cc5820277a7fda624263c6f9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若生是有为，则应有三相。"},{"color":"","id":"fea274324740e5b13633f6c46f4ace2f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若生是无为，何名有为相？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"e54a1cace0c403ad635edfa57eb72719","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、观察有为无为法而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"d63dfe48a672554878661e40e5d00398","modified":1612428947458,"text":"三相若分散，不能有所相。"},{"color":"","id":"c66977d4058afe16f949a420bfc69727","modified":1612428947458,"text":"云何于一处，一时聚三相？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"9eff8811a5a6f63ee3755ce557b87e76","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、观察分散与聚集而破"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"b295ab506cee1874d23374ca2cb7ba59","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若谓生住灭，更有有为相。"},{"id":"108c866db5edb4b4019f27fd846c9c46","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是即为无穷，无即非有为。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"785254ce1569215dec30c0f468a63c2d","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、以太过而破 "},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"f67c59c66a2d6d1a539896d24321539a","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生生之所生，生于彼本生。"},{"color":"","id":"cbc89865e77ba00fa548f534c8726d77","modified":1612428947458,"text":"本生之所生，还生于生生。"},{"id":"1e8d37abd3153e097dc7073eb7c3d91a","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"a9372e79491622f0a4cb89dc1b61e6d4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若谓是生生，能生于本生。"},{"color":"","id":"a00f893ed965c47083599ce80d20f2e5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生生从本生，何能生本生？"},{"id":"10862575c64d4d2ad9c5a2eed320671a","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"c1924a7523f1b8792101d8db8c41560a","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若谓是本生，能生于生生。"},{"color":"","id":"a09f88a0fa19f5632a6ac88fde2c7ea9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"本生从彼生，何能生生生？"},{"id":"872c3cfa1247b1a38d9c08eb95a0dedf","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"8b4ac821c420db58c13fadf3b79718ab","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若彼尚未生，而能生彼法，"},{"color":"","id":"6773f1ebbbf28291455bd8d921a0861a","modified":1612428947458,"text":"汝言正生时，彼生可成立。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"ceb498a413ae56f33d80e8619ca2a8ef","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、以对离过之答复之一而破"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"1d82ab5aa9e3090e5a234b124cbe34e0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如灯能自照，亦能照于彼，"},{"color":"","id":"97f1bddbcef6303379f00758763c0924","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生法亦如是，自生亦生彼。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"047836343707185e6f1d2e5ccd452a29","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、对离过之答复"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"0c3f4bd231c9f698bb84e3ab69620e1e","modified":1612428947458,"text":"灯中自无暗，住处亦无暗。"},{"color":"","id":"78ed388b16722861c028699609cd844c","modified":1612428947458,"text":"破暗乃名照，无暗则无照。"},{"id":"111f5273b9f251ff37349b0ccdcd66ed","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"6c8a21be3e38d31b943b5dd12f3f551a","modified":1612428947458,"text":"此灯正生时，不能及于暗。"},{"color":"","id":"8cae79c653238cb36251343097704b71","modified":1612428947458,"text":"云何灯生时，而能破于暗？"},{"id":"12cb58f179703112749a21edd9afd791","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"d83cc3b599557671d93b7db2bfaa2605","modified":1612428947458,"text":"灯若未及暗，而能破暗者。"},{"color":"","id":"fa42ad5a1e65979df4e180505bcea508","modified":1612428947458,"text":"灯在于此间，则破一切暗。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"f7cbfbdf44a0f937ab77762e72f5241b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、能遍不可得"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"8eb9c7f2431f758e336b5bff8d39b927","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若灯能自照，亦能照于彼。"},{"color":"","id":"bb493e111bf4f1886a624da07b2add23","modified":1612428947458,"text":"暗亦应自暗，亦能暗于彼。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"a369c26d95f5756b8cd3748bce61c9a0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、极为过分"}],"color":"","id":"9a6f8b4d737a22ea1ddc09da24f30034","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、比喻不成"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"uKRIJcNqh8","modified":1612428947458,"text":"此生若未生，云何能自生？"},{"color":"","id":"CCqpKpy4nd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若生已自生，生已何用生？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"uHQ0ZsP2uQ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、自生非理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"LrIzCPGNix","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生非生已生，亦非未生生，"},{"color":"","id":"YuyW5oPk8G","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生时亦不生。去来中已答。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"zm3PjZvzbv","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、总破生"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"xVA8ODHfbb","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若谓生时生，是事已不成。"},{"color":"","id":"uVQGzC19GQ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"云何依生法，尔时而得生？"},{"id":"DToy3jvME6","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"VFSNaw5txX","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法众缘生，即是寂灭性。"},{"color":"","id":"VUtojCtTeP","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是故生生时，是二俱寂灭。"},{"id":"xkvuZ2RGfv","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"x6epYoZ5Y6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若有未生法，说言有生者。"},{"color":"","id":"T7PsCWF4g9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"可生之彼法，不成岂可生？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"uQMWaQUEp6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、别破生时生"}],"color":"","id":"cC3ey9RgMi","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、观察三时"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"sKJkGxvGFp","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若言生时生，是能有所生。"},{"color":"","id":"ZscyxFFQt0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"何得更有生，而能生是生？"},{"id":"0ul6vRyyDw","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"2cuGQF7P0R","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若谓更有生，生生则无穷。"},{"color":"","id":"2XEPvPkIQn","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离生生有生，法皆自能生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"vVJ4exw9qJ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、观察生有否他生"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"Q7yiELs44Q","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、他生非理"}],"color":"","id":"GR1S0nsFhz","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、从因方而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"Bf6XhZtp4J","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有法不应生，无亦不应生，"},{"color":"","id":"7EeBcljLzz","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有无亦不生，此义先已说。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"yTTHkf1T6W","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、从果方而破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"caac43470a4fad0c443c300c9b62425d","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、其义非理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"ad00ace8a611474cf49e0d8d3d0042c0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、遮破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"df3788b056b3af03c132e7c339519cd7","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以对离过之答复之二而破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"e91ee1fc8368cc00e6bee2a6dd16612b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以对离过之答复而破"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"38e5a65d288516a322d0d2eedaf97497","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、观察有无其他法相而破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"d5f874cda9d2363fd038fa4f0649e52a","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、总破"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"jyvUxQqmRv","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若诸法灭时，是时不应生。"},{"color":"","id":"P0fZFCuEqc","modified":1612428947458,"text":"法若不灭者，终无有是事。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"wXuy6vSYHl","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破生"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"LYxKR3xwVh","modified":1612428947458,"text":"不住法不住，住法亦不住，"},{"color":"","id":"ANqKjxvGrL","modified":1612428947458,"text":"住时亦不住，无生云何住？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"LSGV4okct5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、观察三业"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"orhYxn68CK","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若诸法灭时，是则不应住；"},{"color":"","id":"5Pgbapdce4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"法若不灭者，终无有是事。"},{"id":"iKxozhBqwz","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"gRCSx3Lngn","modified":1612428947458,"text":"所有一切法，皆是老死相。"},{"color":"","id":"Wi4OrnleeD","modified":1612428947458,"text":"终不见有法，离老死有住。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"npx4LausLN","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、观察已灭未灭"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"ABQ7J0Xjhw","modified":1612428947458,"text":"住不自相住，亦不异相住。"},{"color":"","id":"91309Paq8q","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如生不自生，亦不异相生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"nbloeFeg2l","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、以前述相同之理而破"}],"color":"","id":"Pxcewb9BfO","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破住"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"iAckbgQj3H","modified":1612428947458,"text":"法已灭不灭，未灭亦不灭，"},{"color":"","id":"7GntNg3Hxk","modified":1612428947458,"text":"灭时亦不灭，无生何有灭?"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"aFo6GLfojR","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、观察所作"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"yRpsmviR5c","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法有住者，是则不应灭；"},{"color":"","id":"nZvOgUskgj","modified":1612428947458,"text":"法若不住者，是亦不应灭。"},{"id":"T8GDyFQ8Ye","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"VEMCl2AQ7k","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是法于是时，不于是时灭；"},{"color":"","id":"Gi1NdVZE8X","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是法于异时，不于异时灭。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"zkzALgKMEr","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、观察所依"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"v6FviYfsxB","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如一切诸法，生相不可得。"},{"color":"","id":"yTD6XTnjsx","modified":1612428947458,"text":"以无生相故，即亦无灭相。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"BiwxhQavmL","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、观察因"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"Ljqgg4TqKD","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法是有者，是即无有灭。"},{"color":"","id":"UDH6OIPRUu","modified":1612428947458,"text":"不应于一法，而有有无相。"},{"id":"VEONYsPZIh","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"eBI4IQ0arI","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法是无者，是则无有灭。"},{"color":"","id":"2OgcCetMVO","modified":1612428947458,"text":"譬如第二头，无故不可断。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"yBS3OQcUlM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"4、观察法之有无"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"yYTGunXLah","modified":1612428947458,"text":"法不自相灭，他相亦不灭，"},{"color":"","id":"nKQNPO41y2","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如自相不生，他相亦不生。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"bVDiclXwYo","modified":1612428947458,"text":"5、以前述之理类推"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"CeOCIHuyp4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、宣说能损之理"},{"color":"","id":"AHJHvgCroM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、遮止自宗相同之过"}],"color":"","id":"UPBiVnYmxw","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、破灭"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"96ceea462dba6374dedbca7c3f41f2fa","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、别破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"004a8262b2fba5a92cac29bee19729ff","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、广说"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"JUNtW0gWFi","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生住灭不成，故无有有为。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"8c1dbb26dd561feb5a0d5ce14be69cd4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、摄义"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"4c9ccfced69e9b13b25998f9011bd5e7","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破有为法 "},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"3NBh0XIzO7","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有为法无故，何得有无为？"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"83770103f7a7d874e674b8f2a89abf58","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、遮破无为法 "},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"DapL0VQIHL","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如幻亦如梦，如乾闼婆城。"},{"color":"","id":"TzLDLCupQG","modified":1612428947458,"text":"所说生住灭，其相亦如是。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"44cb758266d9f1e1352e56dabcf69711","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、遮止与圣教相违"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"e5dcd573cad2702a9f593c03b4d78066","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"0ad5999f296c9340616b188d492bcfd0","modified":1612428947458,"text":"七、观三相品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"8hOwFrS46B","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"SS37l912JA","modified":1612428947458,"text":"决定有作者，不作决定业;"},{"color":"","id":"AwE4ep70wO","modified":1612428947458,"text":"决定无作者，不作无定业。"},{"id":"HgD4hNux7d","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"cuntRR9325","modified":1612428947458,"text":"定作者无作，无作者成业；"},{"color":"","id":"tVPGAuPxY6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有业而无作，无业有作者。"},{"id":"tIn2aRfgBd","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"v1Zkeocijy","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若不定作者，作不定之业，"},{"color":"","id":"RXS4Pl6fFE","modified":1612428947458,"text":"作业堕无因，作者亦无因。"},{"id":"qnL0gYUHrx","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"8h16VN9wns","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若堕于无因，则无因无果，"},{"color":"","id":"Bcj9Jvm2c7","modified":1612428947458,"text":"无作无作者，无所用作法。"},{"id":"v7XiX4NZV8","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"4gEoHwwuWw","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若无作等法，则无有罪福。"},{"color":"","id":"UHkIgt2moD","modified":1612428947458,"text":"罪福等无故，罪福报亦无。"},{"id":"NLjhc73vKM","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"ERzaGVVihP","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若无罪福报，亦无大涅槃。"},{"color":"","id":"s197dINCUd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"诸可有所作，皆空无有果。"},{"id":"rae2GKtMd4","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"R1oeHUBm1S","modified":1612428947458,"text":"作者定不定，不能作二业。"},{"color":"","id":"eqIyK5bbR5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有无相违故，一处则无二。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"XtArGVD8rk","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮遣同品能作所作"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"hxkEjl2KPd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有不能作无，无不能作有。"},{"color":"","id":"CLE3JE86j4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若有作作者，其过如先说。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"pBM18TNK7s","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮遣分别作者作分别业"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"zeA8DOOT8w","modified":1612428947458,"text":"决定之作者，不作不定业，"},{"color":"","id":"eqk8HIueBy","modified":1612428947458,"text":"及定不定业，其过先已说。"},{"id":"o9GmwjT3M1","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"AuLgbJuTcy","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若作者不定，不作决定业，"},{"color":"","id":"7OdMlVe6Gw","modified":1612428947458,"text":"及定不定业，其过先已说。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"ScjZwll4VU","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、遮遣分别作者作分别与二者兼具业"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"GJvwCVVEu8","modified":1612428947458,"text":"作者定不定，亦定亦不定，"},{"color":"","id":"y6KJPMvPAO","modified":1612428947458,"text":"不能作于业，其过先已说。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"rlCifriT5E","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、遮遣二者兼备作者作分别业"}],"color":"","id":"pq2aPdQpJR","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、遮遣违品能作所作"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"HvDJ7vII1t","modified":1612428947458,"text":" 1、胜义中破作业及作者"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"A8PpRJjEfQ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"因业有作者，因作者有业，"},{"color":"","id":"GaziWYY8NG","modified":1612428947458,"text":"成业义如是，更无有余事。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"10K8JKp9KN","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、名言中仅可安立"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"YuDYY9wPcz","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如破作作者，受受者亦尔。"},{"color":"","id":"vWfQjO7qhB","modified":1612428947458,"text":"及一切诸法，亦应如是破。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"kCKFhZZFzV","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、以此理类推"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"vS3Oc7qKAF","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"d242a22108bbff9cf6f74d69c60eb3e1","modified":1612428947458,"text":"八、观作作者品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"GNU66XZW8K","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"id":"QdvJWK6j28","modified":1612428947458,"text":"眼耳等诸根，苦乐等诸法，"},{"id":"KZUlXu6RFT","modified":1612428947458,"text":"谁有如是事，是则名本住。"},{"id":"UuEEilgKBB","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"id":"Bh3OXL1FMp","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若无有本住，谁有眼等法？"},{"id":"YcniTjlY1l","modified":1612428947458,"text":"以是故当知，先已有本住。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"h8WAaiX4zu","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、陈述他宗"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"id":"pBPp6r8Lge","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若离眼等根，及苦乐等法，"},{"id":"gaimEP8N3j","modified":1612428947458,"text":"先有本住者，以何而可知？"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"1hTdZGDD3u","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破无立我之因"},{"children":[{"id":"6Kqrh3SwjF","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若离见法等，而有本住者，"},{"id":"RAA7cZPOAu","modified":1612428947458,"text":"亦应离本住，而有所受法。"},{"id":"6iNxudAQzX","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"id":"R9XlMzhIW8","modified":1612428947458,"text":"以法知有人，以人知有法。"},{"id":"ztHXUD2ztO","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离法何有人？离人何有法？"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"zkls1arwuD","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破立我之因不观待"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"ywb2QQJZiC","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破领受者于一切所领受前成立"},{"children":[{"id":"AObOCDyYn2","modified":1612428947458,"text":"一切见等前，实无有本住，"},{"id":"FoeIPNeTsn","modified":1612428947458,"text":"见等中他法，异时而分别。"},{"id":"uxbhPq0Ha0","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"id":"ia3blppWTv","modified":1612428947458,"text":"一切见等前，若无有本住。"},{"id":"EDv9nFSiQn","modified":1612428947458,"text":"一一见等前，云何能知尘？"},{"id":"Nc6i3kUPxr","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"id":"gkoWQJbEsd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"见者即闻者，闻者即受者，"},{"id":"BJ8BcVJGAv","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是等诸根，则应有本住。"},{"id":"mUArLMRFdi","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"id":"sAb1nETvKr","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若见闻各异，受者亦各异，"},{"id":"u8ANxMW2XU","modified":1612428947458,"text":"见时亦应闻，如是则神多。"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"p2sUozIoa9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破领受者于分别所领受前成立"},{"children":[{"id":"ipOucldZPZ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"眼耳等诸根，苦乐等诸法，"},{"id":"pvQGeCS9Ky","modified":1612428947458,"text":"所从生诸大，彼大亦无神。"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2RvEs7i16Y","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、破领受者存在因法"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"5xfIFiVafG","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破领受者我"},{"children":[{"id":"F6R14bAPMo","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若眼耳等根，苦乐等诸法，"},{"id":"56bFdRnJ31","modified":1612428947458,"text":"无有本住者，见等亦应无。"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"rNKUJfaHA4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以此理亦可遮破他法"},{"children":[{"id":"CYzpigzOFu","modified":1612428947458,"text":"见等无本住，今后亦复无，"},{"id":"Cgiqom5S6o","modified":1612428947458,"text":"以三世无故，无有无分别。"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"c4UlvhryfQ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、以遮遣而摄成立之义"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"SQHApOKa9W","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破其立宗"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"0Um4N1KMgf","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"55acfbbacf38ef5fe3fb705ef2f8f5bd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"九、观本住品"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"e3MJciqGka","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若燃是可燃，作作者则一。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"p244qRKKHW","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、以观察破一体成立"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"Hs1dczK8wi","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若燃异可燃，离可燃有燃。"},{"color":"","id":"zI2O2WjyRk","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是常应燃，不因可燃生。"},{"id":"MDuM61tUKB","modified":1612428947458,"text":"则无燃火功，亦名无作火。"},{"id":"5vkWurHU7E","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"A4UVmRDCey","modified":1612428947458,"text":"燃不待可燃，则不从缘生。"},{"id":"QOWgXNjLol","modified":1612428947458,"text":"火若常燃者，人功则应空。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"WXXa4cPozx","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、以太过而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"D2OMc8aLgE","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若汝谓燃时，名为可燃者。"},{"id":"sb4VGFB2ju","modified":1612428947458,"text":"尔时但有薪，何物燃可燃？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"ZRfmYSPPio","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破离过之答复"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"NpZ08wtjX8","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若异则不至，不至则不烧，"},{"id":"jPdJsAclzM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"不烧则不灭，不灭则常住。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"CpKcGuIocn","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、正破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"Gj80mAOm6L","modified":1612428947458,"text":"燃与可燃异，而能至可燃。"},{"id":"sADGXi3fAY","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如此至彼人，彼人至此人。"},{"id":"blZFBZl7PR","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"HxkWUCYzgy","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若谓燃可燃，二俱相离者。"},{"id":"jlrbv6r7jq","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是燃则能，至于彼可燃。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"nIgel6XzMf","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破离过之答复"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"WLSF6LdQdm","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、宣说其他能损之理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"IuufC3Utlz","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以观察破异体成立"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"gKHl96ikky","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破他宗之安立"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"L6JTAduIpE","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若因可燃燃，因燃有可燃，"},{"id":"fRZHtDzWNv","modified":1612428947458,"text":"先定有何法，而有燃可燃？"},{"id":"JmB5WKUSQ0","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"5J3qon7O1T","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若因可燃燃，则燃成复成。"},{"id":"1oI8DDaH32","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是为可燃中，则为无有燃。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"rTuwC9KAkD","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破前后之观待"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"s1gstk28dC","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法因待成，是法还成待，"},{"id":"GAyx06qPya","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若所待可成，待何成何法？"},{"id":"IA3fKKBWEo","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"vMeibHjiih","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法有待成，未成云何待？"},{"id":"3B0Cb5EmuO","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若成已有待，成已何用待？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"YnljWx27F5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破成与不成之观待"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"0MGEXICUaq","modified":1612428947458,"text":"因可燃无燃，不因亦无燃。"},{"id":"5Har1t5BQW","modified":1612428947458,"text":"因燃无可燃，不因无可燃。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"45RHRP7tUC","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、摄以破成立之义"}],"color":"","id":"T1oYPBFHOb","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、正破观待而立"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"hwaqpno6u4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"燃不余处来，燃处亦无燃。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"tW87CsOs4m","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破可成"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"6Mnqy8JcCt","modified":1612428947458,"text":"可燃亦如是，余如去来说。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"NC2IeoU1gT","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以前述之理类推"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"oDTCUJjzdD","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、宣说旁破他理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2JtBaNjTSE","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破观待而成立"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"PwOjBJJ91i","modified":1612428947458,"text":"可燃即非燃，离可燃无燃，"},{"id":"bQ3FyC3LI1","modified":1612428947458,"text":"燃无有可燃，燃中无可燃。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"kwqMNalkBx","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、摄以破成立之义"}],"color":"","id":"aqbk7uUAwF","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破火与柴薪"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"YrBxwzL64J","modified":1612428947458,"text":"以燃可燃法，说受受者法，"},{"id":"k6o76lpG6Y","modified":1612428947458,"text":"及以说瓶衣，一切等诸法。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"K2G1ejkC2T","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以此理亦可类推他法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"tEp2h5Uhcr","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若人说有我，诸法各异相，"},{"id":"TC4jVGQGPh","modified":1612428947458,"text":"当知如是人，不得佛法味。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"iGkQcb2aEw","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、呵斥违品之见"}],"color":"","id":"XBicCoPIPx","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"id":"lgPbU3e7IX","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"55bd4d8efc974bbdf9315fa5cada9c32","modified":1612428947458,"text":"十、观燃可燃品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"OuxAiMEfa6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"ebq0VDaGI9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"大圣之所说，本际不可得。"},{"id":"eYh8NsLjkk","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生死无有始，亦复无有终。"},{"id":"q6I5zZ2ODj","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"WywM1be3Ll","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若无有始终，中当云何有？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"ZNAMpH6Mor","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、所依之轮回不成立"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"THLB1ykMPM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是故于此中，先后共亦无。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"UpJAodlQjS","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、略说"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"JrIthRgFtw","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若使先有生，后有老死者，"},{"color":"","id":"ta2GbTQO4g","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生则无老死，不死而有生。"},{"id":"IAWqWNzXOT","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"4DGJBZ4qM5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若先有老死，而后有生者，"},{"color":"","id":"9mbuSrq7je","modified":1612428947458,"text":"不生有老死，无因岂能成？"},{"id":"W1h0pFK2K3","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"HFRy83pnnm","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生及于老死，不得一时共。"},{"color":"","id":"GSQI9UXA3Y","modified":1612428947458,"text":"生时则有死，是二俱无因。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"0Nt7TKwdUT","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、广说"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"2m8gXYjVb4","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若使初后共，是皆不然者。"},{"color":"","id":"ahvTSWAKQ2","modified":1612428947458,"text":"何故而戏论，谓有生老死？"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"DjokB0MBuL","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、摄义"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"peaf1F46Nl","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、能依之生死法不成立"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"zr4AXODgQs","modified":1612428947458,"text":"非但于轮回，本际不可得。"},{"id":"NtM8DY5iBZ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"诸所有因果，及相可相法，"},{"id":"EGOlfxEcKS","modified":1612428947458,"text":"受及受者等，所有一切法，"},{"color":"","id":"0PI26cGsHT","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是一切法，本际皆亦无。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"Vs8HDSBxPI","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、以此理亦可类推他法"}],"id":"45ynYrSYEn","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"71dda9930e4b20f5fe56e8977886a39c","modified":1612428947458,"text":"十一、观本际品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"V9PanG6soe","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"xEnW39GvQ9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"自作及他作，共作无因作。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"n0lNI3CdIM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、宣说他宗"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"qzaqHlvQZ3","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是说诸苦，于果则不然。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"4sm4xBElyf","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"BeoAjdMcrB","modified":1612428947458,"text":"苦若自作者，则不从缘生。"},{"color":"","id":"am4XPRTLp3","modified":1612428947458,"text":"因有此阴故，而有彼阴生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"Tfk5wyRjlY","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破以痛苦而自生"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"KCXAx9BBYX","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若人自作苦，离苦何有人？"},{"color":"","id":"TmaRgFSMx5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"而谓于彼人，而能自作苦。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"sahz6z9YeE","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破以补特伽罗而自生"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2EBVU2QoF9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破痛苦为自生"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"tXOkkN7v0Q","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若谓此五阴，异彼五阴者，"},{"color":"","id":"fMuEbdYebI","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是则应言，从他而作苦。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"wm3E0DVW4I","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、破以其他痛苦而生之他生"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"NdfLrszy4K","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若苦他人作，而与此人者，"},{"color":"","id":"aNRJOV3hYd","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若当离于苦，何有此人受？"},{"id":"z06VateYLP","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"hrMZm5tXUx","modified":1612428947458,"text":"苦若彼人作，持与此人者，"},{"color":"","id":"0ERCXabMdf","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离苦何有人，而能授于此？"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"eCAcgwM9kM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破以其他补特伽罗而生之他生"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"aXPchfidcn","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破痛苦为他生"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"wf6lQAAzrv","modified":1612428947458,"text":"自作若不成，云何彼作苦？"},{"color":"","id":"tIfCdVcEwH","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若彼人作苦，即亦名自作。"},{"id":"Ydq052KX3V","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"GfWYO8nooq","modified":1612428947458,"text":"苦不名自作，法不自作法。"},{"color":"","id":"JMGwFggcfD","modified":1612428947458,"text":"彼无有自体，何有彼作苦？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"BOxyD9Y8rG","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、以他理破自生与他生"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"p1kLhZQYWu","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若彼此苦成，应有共作苦。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"22ORgxVOjl","modified":1612428947458,"text":"4、破自他共生"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"6vYzlkeC8R","modified":1612428947458,"text":"此彼尚无作，何况无因作？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"PrtgxuPB41","modified":1612428947458,"text":"5、破无因生"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"FFNepcxnz6","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、广说"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"okFFB733XX","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、阐述能损之理"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"zxNDCZJ8RA","modified":1612428947458,"text":"非但说于苦，四种义不成。"},{"color":"","id":"HN8oJqgFqU","modified":1612428947458,"text":"一切外万物，四义亦不成。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"8G6N0jZe3u","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、以此理亦可类推他法"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"bIVVWUhQ06","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"09a04b8fb2f2a760070f2504d1fba61d","modified":1612428947458,"text":"十二、观苦品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"0ivX6gN1r2","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"iHh0btutvE","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如佛经所说，虚诳妄取相，"},{"color":"","id":"CwA2brCG2W","modified":1612428947458,"text":"诸行妄取故，是名为虚诳。"},{"id":"OTpdSHkaVO","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"TpDkwHeHLR","modified":1612428947458,"text":"虚诳妄取者，是中何所取？"},{"id":"bUpK7xxvIF","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"id":"v7rkARqGkQ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"佛说如是事，欲以示空义。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"EgEYcUDhSL","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、宣说教义"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"QRFwYuyr00","modified":1612428947458,"text":"诸法有异故，知皆是无性。"},{"id":"jkwLDc4ucU","modified":1612428947458,"text":"无性法亦无，一切法空故。"},{"id":"JNgjTUK7O4","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"id":"DVBKAtj8Rz","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若诸法无性，云何而有异？"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"ODlxc6jzFE","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、宣说他宗"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"NO6nBBKx5H","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若诸法有性，云何而得异？"},{"id":"Z47yTChoSu","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"AFoJTi1dx9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是法则无异，异法亦无异。"},{"color":"","id":"hSSn3wHs6D","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如壮不作老，老亦不作老。"},{"id":"3SPXSZZpOQ","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","finish":false,"id":"V4DSLI6ij9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若是法即异，乳即应是酪。"},{"finish":false,"id":"fSSrqVZULx","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离乳有何法，而能作于酪？"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"NC0oGFml3b","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破其立论"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"pvp05CqckN","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破承许其他立宗"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"7ZszrrK6pr","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若有不空法，则应有空法。"},{"id":"cgbhC2Kw3g","modified":1612428947458,"text":"实无不空法，何得有空法？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"16xhDLA8IH","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、驳斥其他争辩"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"IZUxbypqRc","modified":1612428947458,"text":"大圣说空法，为离诸见故。"},{"id":"JfHj6ngjps","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若复见有空，诸佛所不化。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"IxsFMGkzoz","modified":1612428947458,"text":"4、宣说空性之必要"}],"id":"zIfeBrOVAM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"fe793db882f80d668151273ac119fe6f","modified":1612428947458,"text":"十三、观行品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"5b0mIo1I4h","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"0P5LMopeJ1","modified":1612428947458,"text":"见可见见者，是三各异方，"},{"id":"WzBVvNAKAj","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是三法异，终无有合时。"},{"id":"ENS6p6zEnQ","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"io5y6O1NJt","modified":1612428947458,"text":"染与于可染，染者亦复然。"},{"id":"Car2MmDpIl","modified":1612428947458,"text":"余入余烦恼，皆亦复如是。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"NvpDBqSuCC","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、以立宗而略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"U6LOkUuV33","modified":1612428947458,"text":"异法当有合，见等无有异，"},{"id":"jH8XmsoBRp","modified":1612428947458,"text":"异相不成故，见等云何合？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"uExFRlu43m","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"MAuSmBcZhO","modified":1612428947458,"text":"非但可见等，异相不可得。"},{"id":"KCcIOqvFcn","modified":1612428947458,"text":"所有一切法，皆亦无异相。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"fwNklTQpvO","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、以此理类推他法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"Q7QxqHJt13","modified":1612428947458,"text":"异因异有异，异离异无异。"},{"id":"rop933tBRl","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法所因出，是法不异因。"},{"id":"t9urwcveNE","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"Ii6v0htK4W","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若离从异异，应无异有异。"},{"id":"WJSrIfHAOX","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离从异无异，是故无有异。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"YXh249SjvK","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、破异体之本体"}],"color":"","id":"D41WaKlQNu","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、宣说以本体成立的异法不合理"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"jwqQKVQduq","modified":1612428947458,"text":"异中无异相，不异中亦无。"},{"id":"tQsJaj8q7v","modified":1612428947458,"text":"无有异相故，则无此彼异。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"BV6RUw7xT9","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、宣说异体之总相不成立"}],"color":"","id":"EPlxS9kpHt","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、广说理证"}],"color":"","id":"YFeDBdnvxT","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、以有法不成立证明接触不成立"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"3xvuIDIO9u","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是法不自合，异法亦不合。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"pySn3kwNV5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、以无有一异证明接触不成立"}],"color":"","id":"ZkMvyEEkOG","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、广说合理论据"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"j0RdfPP6gP","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是法不自合，异法亦不合。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3fJI3zfabG","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、摄以破成立之义"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"v3yuUk2vfZ","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"d3c806bc066720b999346015f1619c18","modified":1612428947458,"text":"十四、观和合品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"pbX1NJvvJl","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"FXcdH6jmIv","modified":1612428947458,"text":"众缘中有性，是事则不然。"},{"color":"","id":"9w9MzCGIg3","modified":1612428947458,"text":"性从众缘出，即名为作法。"},{"id":"62Q39vrDax","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"wZx8W5Vehr","modified":1612428947458,"text":"性若是作者，云何有此义？"},{"id":"0D4CAS6IuY","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"yHDiCwuQ0Y","modified":1612428947458,"text":"性名为无作，不待异法成。"},{"id":"hZR9IlCRAg","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"T28ox3G1Fy","modified":1612428947458,"text":"法若无自性，云何有他性?"},{"color":"","id":"oZwOvbbu4R","modified":1612428947458,"text":"自性于他性，亦名为他性。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"fblrdlHQRE","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破自性与他性"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"5gltP5a6zW","modified":1612428947458,"text":"离自性他性，何得更有法？"},{"color":"","id":"yulskIl6la","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若有自他性，诸法则得成。"},{"id":"nmiwixvf6k","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"lnHXGR9BxC","modified":1612428947458,"text":"有若不成者，无云何可成？"},{"color":"","id":"2bVAZmIrLY","modified":1612428947458,"text":"因有异法故，有坏名为无。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"m0CLt5qpH3","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、遮破有实与无实"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"kwSUuiJe37","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破四种戏论"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"60UuFvrhJr","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若人见有无，见自性他性，"},{"color":"","id":"xnUgmfRsYP","modified":1612428947458,"text":"如是则不见，佛法真实义。"},{"id":"dOP8pjKDpO","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"iXiIYpmsUi","modified":1612428947458,"text":"佛能灭有无，于化迦旃延，"},{"color":"","id":"LhMmlHI4Uo","modified":1612428947458,"text":"经中之所说，离有亦离无。"},{"id":"Yi0ouTHFhN","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"iWnpuKJPVf","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法实有性，后则不应无。"},{"color":"","id":"MkRLVPoBtg","modified":1612428947458,"text":"性若有异相，是事终不然。"},{"id":"7jIxKWhm8P","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"v1PkOhTeiM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法实无性，云何而可异？"},{"color":"","id":"vE4ekN0I3l","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法实有性，云何而可异？"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"ApVBAXVgGw","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、呵责相违之见"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"zYkBNPIIBa","modified":1612428947458,"text":"定有则著常，定无则著断。"},{"color":"","id":"iUuPaWmqzb","modified":1612428947458,"text":"是故有智者，不应著有无。"},{"id":"AqL7x3VCnT","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"AOEd3GWyXM","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若法有定性，非无则是常。"},{"color":"","id":"qFBl8p0uFB","modified":1612428947458,"text":"先有而今无，是则为断灭。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"DCAVxTpBmU","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、教诫修习中观"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"GJwkUf4pVU","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":3,"id":"c793e91f4a91937a91822eba09ec5be1","modified":1612428947458,"text":"十五、观有无品"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"ZsThZ7q59l","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、经部关联"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"WzYfTLKV26","modified":1612428947458,"text":"诸行往来者，常不应往来。"},{"color":"","id":"fmIWMnRaTc","modified":1612428947458,"text":"无常亦不应，众生亦复然。"},{"id":"EvEDPpT2pB","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"qz9vqDedvG","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若众生往来，阴界诸入中，"},{"color":"","id":"OUluguJLbA","modified":1612428947458,"text":"五种求尽无，谁有往来者？"},{"id":"LSksZwK4H3","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"P8aFc1zku5","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若从身至身，往来即无身，"},{"color":"","id":"gV0s59XZAy","modified":1612428947458,"text":"若其无有身，则无有往来。"},{"id":"ientPCp0O3","modified":1612428947458,"text":""},{"color":"","id":"Ez1bjiDsv3","modified":1612428947458,"text":"诸行若灭者，是事终不然；"},{"color":"","id":"DRE2dpt9ie","modified":1612428947458,"text":"众生若灭者，是事亦不然。"}],"color":"","id":"OHAvr1K7bU","modified":1612428947458,"text":"1、遮破轮回与涅槃"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"0tFA0LB61y","modified":1612428947458,"text":"诸行生灭相，不缚亦不解；"},{"color":"","id":"dykZZt4KCU","modified":1612428947458,"text":"众生如先说，不缚亦不解。"}],"color":"","id":"mQ1GStUM5k","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、遮破束缚与解脱"},{"color":"","id":"jJ8hFsvTSx","modified":1612428947458,"text":"3、驳斥其他过患"}],"id":"QjfSIyhiuD","modified":1612428947458,"text":"2、品关联"}],"collapsed":true
